t: Google Login Test With Selenium Persistence Plan For & By AI
s: This article focuses on achieving session persistence in Selenium browser automation for tasks like Google login, prioritizing the creation of 'deliverable-makers' that empower SEO consultants, rather than one-off deliverables. The core technical challenge is maintaining browser session state across instances.
sub: Selenium browser automation and session persistence
Achieving Google login persistence using browser profiles
Transitioning from Puppeteer/Playwright to Selenium for persistence
